Recorded claim:
At revision f3f51b662624a5d14774cf9fe3d5def6822b77ae, the Account Hub large radio card was changed to set its accessible name from its text and update it when a slot changes. The code normalizes whitespace and removes aria-label when the text is empty. This describes the patch’s intended behavior; the supplied evidence does not show a runtime accessibility check.

Provenance: 827e4c2637c58cb1bb3bf6db511cfccd9bbdf63c65154012c72833955822abce. Original evidence IDs: 7b6ebf1e6ad6399983d2c0ae823e699719d35553ab958b99592d7b3111604cd9.
This is a recorded historical interpretation, not independent source verification. Source quotes from personal imports or unconfirmed-access records remain private. Historical test results are reported outcomes; no tests were rerun for this backfill.
Source references:
https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/f3f51b662624a5d14774cf9fe3d5def6822b77ae
